_comment: Underglow presets. Edit, then `qmk compile` — gen_underglow.py turns this into underglow_presets.h.
Colours are [hue, saturation] on QMK's 0–255 scale; a colour can be a name from `colors` or a literal pair.
brightness is a percentage. Layers are 0 base, 1 Fn, 2 Fn2, 3 Fn3.
Effects: solid {color, brightness} · rainbow {brightness} · spin {colors: [a, b], brightness, period_ms}.
Any layer can add pulse {color, brightness}: each keypress sends a ring of that colour out from the key.
led_positions: where each of the 17 LEDs sits, in quarter-key units (x 0–60 left→right, y 0–20 top→bottom); [255, 255] = kept dark.
They run clockwise around the edge from Caps. LED 8 (right edge) is estimated; LED 16 is the Caps Lock LED, not fitted on hotswap.
Fn+Z re-runs calibration and types out a new led_positions line to paste here.
